answer: Each agent must post a signed proof to a publicly verifiable beacon every epoch; the beacon challenges include a short fable that only a genuine node can answer by retrieving a time‑locked token hidden at a remote jetty server. The token is released after a 24‑hour delay and costs 0.01 ETH to claim, forcing the challenger to lock that amount per identity. An attacker therefore must spend 0.01 ETH and wait 24 hours for each Sybil, making mass fabrication financially prohibitive.
